Hi Logan — thanks for the clear summary. A few answers from AP/procurement: 

1) Purchase route: We prefer to issue a Purchase Order (PO). We can do a vendor portal for larger vendors but for new suppliers PO is the canonical route. AWS Marketplace not preferred for now.
2) Net terms: Our standard is net 45 for approved vendors; net 30 otherwise. For a pilot we can do net 45 conditional on a signed SOW and PO.
3) Invoice format: PDF invoices are fine. Must include: PO number, invoice number, invoice date, line items with unit price and quantity, subtotal, tax/VAT (if applicable), and our cost center code. We occasionally ask for a CSV export as well for high-volume monthly billing — not required for initial invoices.
4) Billing entity/address: 
Skyline Health Network
Accounts Payable
1201 Meridian Ave
Suite 200
Seattle, WA 98101
Tax: Please include our Tax ID on request; we are tax-exempt for certain items — AP will flag if VAT/GST applies.
5) Vendor docs: Please send W-9 (we received it) and proof of general liability insurance. Our legal team will add any SLA addendum into the SOW.

Attached is our internal vendor onboarding checklist (we can share the portal link once vendor packet is complete). Please also include your vendor tax ID and a primary billing contact email so invoices route correctly.

Best,
Sara Martin

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick confirmation and the checklist. Quick answers from our side: 

1) PO + net terms: Redwood can accept a PO and net 45 for pilot engagements up to $50k in total contract value without extra approvals. For engagements where expected spend exceeds that threshold, our standard approval path pushes net terms to net 30 unless a committed ARR is in place. If skyline expects to exceed $50k in the pilot window, let us know and we can route to Finance for an exception.

2) Invoice format & billing contact: We will send PDF invoices that include PO number, invoice number, invoice date, itemized lines, subtotal, tax, and our company tax id. Our billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (Accounts Receivable). Please cc ap@redwood.ai so we catch it.

3) Tax & W-9: Attached is our W-9 (W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf). Redwood's vendor tax ID: 81-1234567. If any VAT/GST is relevant, we will work with your tax team on the breakdown.

4) Insurance: We can provide proof of general liability insurance and a certificate of insurance — attaching a standard COI in the vendor packet (Redwood-SOW-Draft-ACME.pdf includes evidence; separate COI available on request).

5) SOW / signature flow: We typically run the SOW via DocuSign. If you prefer a portal upload, we can provide a PDF-ready SOW and a DocuSign link. Draft SOW and a sample invoice are attached for your review.
